_comment: Keyed by <category>/<slug>. scripts/build-creative-art.py merges these into public/images/animation/manifest.json, which /creative reads. Missing entries fall back to a title derived from the slug.

3d/sculpt-primitive-forms.title: Sculpt study — primitive forms
3d/sculpt-primitive-forms.note: Grey box-modelling exercise: a sphere grown into radial pods, a pill form, and floating discs above a plane.

3d/low-poly-fantasy-house.title: Low-poly fantasy house
3d/low-poly-fantasy-house.note: Modelled and textured house with turrets, a hanging banner, and outbuildings on a low-poly base.

3d/character-rig-pose.title: Character rig — pose test
3d/character-rig-pose.note: Rigged figure posed in the viewport, checking joint placement and limb deformation.

3d/skeleton-rig.title: Skeleton rig — bone hierarchy
3d/skeleton-rig.note: The same character's skeleton drawn out in full so the chain from hips to fingertips is readable.

3d/dog-robot-concept.title: Dog robot — concept passes
3d/dog-robot-concept.note: Orthographic study sheets for a quadruped robot, working the head unit from several angles.

3d/sculpt-twisted-log.title: Sculpt study — twisted log
3d/sculpt-twisted-log.note: A cylinder worked into a twisted, draping form with the ridges of the twist carried through the surface.

3d/maya-animation-context.title: Maya — animation setup
3d/maya-animation-context.note: Working Maya session showing the graph editor and channel box alongside the animated object.

3d/sculpt-metal-flower.title: Sculpt study — metal flower
3d/sculpt-metal-flower.note: Petals unwrapping from a central core, shaded in a polished metal to test how the curves read.

3d/character-render-officer.title: Character render — officer
3d/character-render-officer.note: Finished render of a uniformed character, kept dark against a flat backdrop.

3d/creature-sculpt-dragon.title: Creature sculpt — dragon head
3d/creature-sculpt-dragon.note: Green dragon head sculpt worked up from the jaw, with the open mouth as the focal point.

3d/insect-render.title: Insect — modelled and shaded
3d/insect-render.note: Winged insect built and shaded against a pale backdrop, testing transparency in the wings.

3d/low-poly-house-lighting.title: Low-poly house — lighting pass
3d/low-poly-house-lighting.note: The house at night, lit only by window emissives and a few ground lights.

3d/sculpt-vessel.title: Sculpt study — vessel
3d/sculpt-vessel.note: Organic form pulled out of a simple vase silhouette, with a branch handle curving off the body.

digital/dark-birds-painting.title: Birds — dark palette painting
digital/dark-birds-painting.note: Loose painted study with a flock moving through a dark, swirling ground.

digital/figure-in-rain.title: Figure in rain
digital/figure-in-rain.note: Monochrome figure study where the rain strokes do most of the shading.

digital/figure-turnaround.title: Figure turnaround — construction
digital/figure-turnaround.note: Four views of one figure kept to pure construction lines, drawn on ruled paper.

digital/samurai-illustration.title: Samurai — painted illustration
digital/samurai-illustration.note: A samurai mid-strike, built around a red cape and a spray of white strokes against black.

digital/portrait-blocked-colour.title: Portrait — blocked colour
digital/portrait-blocked-colour.note: Portrait reduced to flat blocks of yellow and blue with the line work left showing.

digital/environment-before-after.title: Environment before and after
digital/environment-before-after.note: The same hillside shown brown and bare, then again after a lighting and foliage pass.

digital/wolf-graphic-portrait.title: Wolf — graphic portrait
digital/wolf-graphic-portrait.note: High-contrast treatment: the head sits in white against black, with the eyes left empty.

digital/figure-study-backlit.title: Figure study — backlit
digital/figure-study-backlit.note: A leaning figure read entirely as silhouette against a pale ground.

digital/abandoned-truck.title: Abandoned truck — vehicle study
digital/abandoned-truck.note: Rust, dents, and foliage reclaiming a parked truck, painted over loose line work.

digital/hero-foreshortened-punch.title: Hero cover — foreshortened punch
digital/hero-foreshortened-punch.note: Comic-style cover practising hard foreshortening, with the fist driving into the viewer.

digital/character-sheet-sketch-to-colour.title: Character sheet — sketch to colour
digital/character-sheet-sketch-to-colour.note: Construction sketches of a masked character beside the finished flat-colour version.

digital/crest-set.title: Crest set — icon design
digital/crest-set.note: A family of circular emblems in red and black, drawn to work together at small sizes.

digital/bee-studies.title: Bee studies
digital/bee-studies.note: Three deliberately unfinished insect studies, used to stay out of tight rendering.

digital/glowing-grove.title: Glowing grove — lighting study
digital/glowing-grove.note: Canopy scene lit from the ground, testing how far coloured bounce light carries.

digital/portrait-red-tie.title: Portrait — red tie
digital/portrait-red-tie.note: Portrait held to a tight palette, with the red tie carrying the whole composition.

digital/phoenix-illustration.title: Phoenix — painted illustration
digital/phoenix-illustration.note: Bird mid-flight in front of a red disc, wings built from broad brush strokes.

digital/parking-structure.title: Parking structure — environment render
digital/parking-structure.note: Repeated concrete bays shot through with hard daylight, testing depth and repetition.

digital/dog-character-studies.title: Dog character — exploratory sketches
digital/dog-character-studies.note: Rough passes on a small robot dog with oversized eyes, plus thumbnails from the side and back.

digital/material-palette.title: Material palette — texture studies
digital/material-palette.note: Shaded spheres and flat swatches setting out the metals, fabrics, foliage, and wood for a scene.

digital/environment-concept.title: Jungle environment — concept
digital/environment-concept.note: Environment concept pushing a bright canopy against a darker forest floor.

traditional/still-life-skull-and-pots.title: Still life — skull and pots
traditional/still-life-skull-and-pots.note: Dark tonal still life built from graphite blocks rather than outlines.

traditional/still-life-skull-teaset.title: Still life — skull tea set
traditional/still-life-skull-teaset.note: Warm burnt-sienna study on a table edge, with the skull as the highest contrast.

traditional/rose-study.title: Rose — pencil still life
traditional/rose-study.note: Rose drawn from life, worked light enough to leave the paper as the highlight.

traditional/corridor-perspective.title: Corridor — one-point perspective
traditional/corridor-perspective.note: A small figure at the end of a long corridor, with every line converging on it.

traditional/glass-building-perspective.title: Glass building — perspective study
traditional/glass-building-perspective.note: Two-point perspective exercise on a glass facade, all structure and no shading.

traditional/portrait-charcoal.title: Portrait — charcoal
traditional/portrait-charcoal.note: Head-and-shoulders portrait built from a few broad tonal masses and a strong light side.

traditional/figure-blue-tones.title: Figure — blue tones
traditional/figure-blue-tones.note: Kneeling figure in a cool blue range, with the pose carried by mass rather than contour.

traditional/seated-figure-charcoal.title: Seated figure — charcoal
traditional/seated-figure-charcoal.note: Academic study working through weight, proportion, and where the body actually contacts the seat.

traditional/seated-figure-study.title: Seated figure — raised arm
traditional/seated-figure-study.note: Full-figure study with the arm raised, emphasising the twist through the torso.

traditional/seated-figure-tonal.title: Seated figure — tonal study
traditional/seated-figure-tonal.note: Quiet graphite study looking down, kept deliberately soft except at the face and hands.

traditional/blossom-tree.title: Blossom tree — colour study
traditional/blossom-tree.note: Bright canopy against a warm sky, the only saturated passage in an otherwise muted sheet.

traditional/figure-magenta.title: Figure — magenta
traditional/figure-magenta.note: Figure cut out against a maroon ground and outlined in magenta to separate it.

traditional/landscape-lake.title: Landscape — lake
traditional/landscape-lake.note: Water, bank, and foliage worked in warm earth tones with the reflection doing the perspective.

traditional/figure-and-creature.title: Figure and creature
traditional/figure-and-creature.note: A figure standing over something small and bright, kept loose in greens and browns.

traditional/sleeping-cat.title: Sleeping cat — tonal study
traditional/sleeping-cat.note: Soft-edged charcoal study of a sleeping cat with the ground plane left almost untouched.

traditional/figure-in-flame.title: Figure in flame
traditional/figure-in-flame.note: Figure dissolving into colour at the edges, with handwritten text worked into the upper right.

traditional/abstract-glasses.title: Abstract — white on black
traditional/abstract-glasses.note: Scribbled glasses and a ring reduced to pure black and white shapes.

traditional/hands-study.title: Hands — sketch study
traditional/hands-study.note: Reclining figure and hands roughed in on toned paper, mostly unresolved on purpose.

traditional/figure-drawing.title: Figure drawing — two figures
traditional/figure-drawing.note: Two figures built from the same light source, with the underdrawing left visible.

ui-design/IMG_3551.title: Scene layout — incident street
ui-design/IMG_3551.note: Low-fidelity layout of the environment the operator is dropped into: the storefront row, an impact point in the roadway, and a fire at the far corner, left unlabelled so the layout reads before the detail does.

ui-design/IMG_3558.title: Scene states — annotated incidents
ui-design/IMG_3558.note: The same street annotated with the three incidents the app has to surface: civilian casualty, a drone/pedestrian collision, and the active fire, each with the callout that triggered it.

ui-design/IMG_3555.title: Controller mapping — teleport and snap turn
ui-design/IMG_3555.note: Input design for the VR controller: teleport, exit VR/menu, mission-aware pick-up, LiDAR-sourced targeting, and snap turn, laid out around a window cut in the sheet so the scene sits inside the mapping.

ui-design/IMG_3557.title: Controller mapping — active fire state
ui-design/IMG_3557.note: The same mapping restated against the active-fire state, with the sensor-log card that raises the alert sitting over the scene.

ui-design/IMG_3559.title: Controller mapping — interior layout
ui-design/IMG_3559.note: Mapping paired with the interior layout, working through how the operator reads and picks up evidence inside the room.
